entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: Cobra-headed god of strength on Amonkhet, later remade as a God-Eternal.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: Agent of Nicol Bolas who slew Rhonas with poison.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker whose plan led to Rhonas's death and who remade him as a God-Eternal.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who destroyed Rhonas with the Blackblade.

entities.name: Blackblade
entities.description: Weapon Gideon used to strike down Rhonas.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Massive animated elemental torn apart by the Eternals.

entities.name: Jessie Zane
entities.description: Assassin who spread Rhonas's strength to other planes.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: Plane to which Rhonas's strength spread.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Plane of the War of the Spark.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Battle on Ravnica where Rhonas was destroyed.

events.summary: The Scorpion God confronts Rhonas near the Luxa River in the Hour of Glory and slays him with poison.
events.quote: Rhonas fought bravely but was ultimately slain in combat by the Scorpion God's deadly poison

events.summary: Bolas remakes the zombified Rhonas as a God-Eternal.
events.quote: Rhonas was zombified and remade by Bolas as one of the terrifying God-Eternals .

events.summary: During the War of the Spark, Rhonas helps tear apart the Vitu-Ghazi elemental.
events.quote: Rhonas took part in tearing apart the massive animated Vitu-Ghazi elemental

events.summary: Gideon Jura destroys Rhonas with the Blackblade.
events.quote: he was finally destroyed by Gideon Jura , who struck him down with the Blackblade
